upstream.description: Undetected web-scraping & seamless HTML parsing in Python!

classification.analysis: Stealth-Requests is a Python HTTP library, API-compatible with `requests`, that uses curl_cffi to mimic Chrome's TLS/HTTP fingerprint for undetected web scraping, with automatic User-Agent rotation, Referer tracking, and built-in retry logic for 429/503/522 responses. Its response object adds convenience methods for extracting emails, phone numbers, images, links, and HTML tables, converting pages to Lxml/BeautifulSoup trees, and rendering HTML to Markdown, with both sync and asyncio session support. Aimed at developers building scrapers or data-extraction pipelines who want fewer blocks and less parsing boilerplate than raw `requests` + `bs4`.

use_cases.title: Scrape a site without triggering bot-detection fingerprinting
Extract emails, links, and tables from a page in one call
Convert a scraped webpage into clean Markdown for an LLM pipeline
Run concurrent async scraping sessions with automatic retries
